rationale: C14 is a direct predecessor manual whose effective-date and transition provisions are reproduced in the child with the dates and institutional scope updated. The child retains the same sequence: prospective application of the new manual, preservation of proceedings already begun, protection against retroactive criminalization, and preservation of the prior maximum punishment. This is concrete, material drafting reuse, not merely a shared military-justice topic. C20 contains nearly identical transition language because it adopted C14 for the Air Force, while C13 supplies related court-martial procedure but is less clearly the template for the child as a whole.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This manual shall be in force and effect in the armed forces of the United States on and after May 31, 1951, with respect to all court-martial processes taken on and after May 31, 1951
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This manual shall be in force and effect in the Army of the United States on and after February 1, 1949 with respect to all court-martial processes taken on or after February 1, 1949
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim effective-date clause with the service scope and date updated.

shared_material.child_excerpt: nothing contained in this manual shall be construed to invalidate any investigation, trial in which arraignment has been had, or other action begun prior to May 31, 1951; and any investigation, trial, or action so begun may be completed
shared_material.parent_excerpt: nothing contained in this manual shall be construed to invalidate any investigation, trial in which arraignment has been had, or other action begun prior to February 1, 1949; and any such investigation, trial, or action so begun may be completed
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive preservation clause follows the same wording and operative sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: nothing contained in this manual shall be construed to make punishable any act done or omitted prior to the effective date of this manual which was not punishable when done or omitted
shared_material.parent_excerpt: nothing contained in this manual shall be construed to make punishable any act done or omitted prior to the effective date of this manual which was not punishable when done or omitted

shared_material.child_excerpt: the maximum punishment for an offense committed prior to May 31, 1951, shall not exceed the applicable limit in effect at the time of the commission of such offense
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the maximum punishment for an offense committed prior to February 1, 1949, shall not exceed the applicable limit in effect at the time of the commission of such offense
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim punishment-saving provision with only the controlling date changed.
